title: KBD stage handoff
description: Handoff artifact written by stageHandoffWrite/stageHandoffSkip (lib/kbd/stage-gate.mjs) into <phase-dir>/handoffs/<stage>.handoff.json. Semantically validated at every stage boundary; at the Plan→Execute boundary the identity object is REQUIRED (mini #60).

identity.description: OPTIONAL for assess/analyze/spec handoffs, REQUIRED by the Plan→Execute boundary (enforced by lib/kbd/stage-gate.mjs). Binds the handoff to canonical identity and the adopted contract so stale or foreign handoffs are rejected instead of silently accepted. Written via ctx.identity or KBD_HANDOFF_IDENTITY_JSON.

runId.description: Canonical run id from prometheus kbd status.

phaseId.description: Canonical phase id; must equal the phase directory the handoff lives in.

planRevision.description: Plan revision the handoff was produced against.

contractDigest.description: SHA-256 of the adopted contract under the contract's digestNormalization (identity.contractDigest and identity.planRevision excluded).
